capabilities.name: Create open save and close production
capabilities.description: Create and persist native Movie/Animation projects.
capabilities.notes: Native .plmovie.json project creation and persistence are validated.

capabilities.name: Production sequence shot hierarchy
capabilities.description: Organize productions into sequences, scenes, shots, takes, and assets with metadata and statuses.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.7.1 — Production model workspaces shots timeline tracks and layers
capabilities.notes: Basic project metadata exists but the full production hierarchy does not.

capabilities.name: Timeline engine
capabilities.description: Provide engine-backed timeline state, ranges, tracks, clips, activity, layout, and navigation.
capabilities.notes: Engine foundation exists; full editing operations, track hierarchy, snapping, markers, and shot operations remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Timeline playback and preview
capabilities.description: Preview timeline state with playback controls and frame-aware timing.
capabilities.notes: Playback engine foundation is validated but not yet a finished media-preview system.

capabilities.name: Keyframe animation
capabilities.description: Create and manipulate property keyframes with interpolation and timing controls.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.7.2 — Keyframes curves dope sheet and 3D animation
capabilities.notes: Keyframe engine exists; complete editing and interpolation UI remains unfinished.

capabilities.name: Graph editor and dope sheet
capabilities.description: Edit animation curves, timing, interpolation handles, key categories, and retiming.

capabilities.name: 3D property animation
capabilities.description: Animate object hierarchy, transforms, cameras, lights, materials, and properties.

capabilities.name: 2D frame and vector animation
capabilities.description: Support drawing, brushes, frame exposure, onion skin, vector shapes, paths, and reusable symbols.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.7.3 — 2D vector cutout rigging skinning and character tools

capabilities.name: Rigging and character animation basics
capabilities.description: Provide rigs, constraints, controllers, weights, morph targets, poses, clips, and animation layers.

capabilities.name: Storyboard and animatic workflow
capabilities.description: Create storyboard panels, views, exports, animatics, and reviewable shot sequences.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.7.4 — Storyboards animatics camera motion graphics and cinematics

capabilities.name: Cinematic camera tools
capabilities.description: Support camera rigs, cuts, composition, shot preview, and camera animation.

capabilities.name: Motion graphics
capabilities.description: Create animated shapes, text, presets, reusable symbols, and timeline-driven motion graphics.

capabilities.name: Video editing
capabilities.description: Support multi-track video editing, clip arrangement, trimming, transitions, and timing operations.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.7.5 — Video audio effects compositing and color
capabilities.notes: Video track/clip foundations exist, but real editing functionality remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Audio editing and synchronization
capabilities.description: Provide waveforms, trimming, fades, levels, synchronization, and multi-track audio.
capabilities.notes: Default audio tracks exist, but real audio editing does not.

capabilities.name: Effects and compositing
capabilities.description: Provide effect stacks, masks, adjustment layers, blending, basic node compositing, and color correction.

capabilities.name: Animation render and export
capabilities.description: Queue and produce stills, image sequences, video, audio, review exports, and game-animation outputs.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.7.6 — Render export assets AI and cross-slice
capabilities.notes: Rendering and export are explicitly absent from the Stage 3 Movie Studio.

capabilities.name: Production asset linking
capabilities.description: Manage linked production assets, versions, dependencies, relinking, updates, and packaging.

capabilities.name: Cross-slice animation workflows
capabilities.description: Use Docs scripts, Sheets production data, Code scripts and shaders, Modeler assets, and Game cinematics and clips.

capabilities.name: AI production proposals
capabilities.description: Provide reviewable AI timing, production, shot, marker, animation, and render proposals.

capabilities.name: Production history and recovery
capabilities.description: Provide snapshots, autosave, crash recovery, and durable production history.
